text:
ashley: kicking off staggered 10->25% canary for inference v2.3 now (eu-west1 + ap-south1). tagging ops for stop/go.

deploy-bot: rollout started: v2.3 -> 10% traffic in eu-west1, ap-south1. canary_id=cb-1753219876.

sam: noticed ap-south tail latency bump ~17:02 UTC, p50 ok but p99 ~480ms and a few 502 spikes. metrics -> https://grafana/redwood/d/…/canary-cb-1753219876

ashley: thanks sam. is this sustained or a blip?

tony: I see a pattern — request rate oscillating every 20s in ap-south, correlates with autoscaler thrash on nodegroup-a. possible pre-warming issue for kv-cache.

mira: QA reports a couple of prompt-format regressions in ap-south sample set (2/200). not sure related but flagging.

ashley: we need a quick call: hold region, pin to v2.2 for ap-south, or continue and monitor? prefer minimal blast radius.

leo: vote: -> hold ap-south and continue eu-west at 10%. we can pin ap-south to v2.2 using routing override.

jamie: +1 to hold ap-south. release notes already mention minor beam search change in v2.3 — could affect tail behavior.

sam: ops action: pausing ap-south traffic to v2.3 now.

deploy-bot: action: route-override applied: ap-south1 -> pinned v2.2 (canary traffic unmapped). log: route-override/1753219876/ps.

ashley: thanks — can we also snapshot the sample requests hitting ap-south for postmortem?

tony: grabbing logs and KV-cache metrics, will upload to the incident folder.

mira: adding failing samples to eval harness now. pinged @models-research for quick triage.

jamie: can we defer broader rollout until we've validated kv-cache warmup + 1000 synthetic requests? propose resume in 2 hours if green.

ashley: agreed. formal stopcall: ap-south held. eu-west stays at 10%. resume decision at +2h unless new signals. thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary cb-1753219876 status: PARTIAL_PAUSED (ap-south pinned -> v2.2). watchers: ashley, sam, tony.

leo: noted for changelog: rolled back ap-south routing -> pinned v2.2. will update release tracker and customer-impact board.

sam: recording this as a "stopgap hold" — not a full rollback. if regressions worsen we'll escalate to full rollback.

ashley: closing loop: please post final decision in this thread when you have the postmortem or if we decide full rollback.

mira: will post failing sample list + eval results in ~30m.

tony: uploading metrics snapshot now.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: resume-check in 2h (1753227076).

ashley: thanks team.
